description: This file defines types and interfaces related to the browser server context and runtime state management, including profile runtime states, server state, profile actions, routing context, profile status, and context options.

methods.name: ensureBrowserAvailable
methods.description: Ensures that the browser is available.

methods.name: ensureTabAvailable
methods.description: Ensures that a browser tab with the specified targetId is available.

methods.name: isHttpReachable
methods.description: Checks if the HTTP endpoint is reachable within an optional timeout.

methods.name: isReachable
methods.description: Checks if the browser is reachable within an optional timeout.

methods.name: listTabs
methods.description: Lists the currently open browser tabs.

methods.name: openTab
methods.description: Opens a new browser tab with the specified URL.

methods.name: focusTab
methods.description: Focuses the tab with the given targetId.

methods.name: closeTab
methods.description: Closes the tab with the specified targetId.

methods.name: resetProfile
methods.description: Resets the browser profile, optionally moving data from one profile to another.

methods.name: forProfile
methods.description: Gets the profile context for a specific profile name.

methods.name: listProfiles
methods.description: Lists all available profiles with their status.

methods.name: mapTabError
methods.description: Maps an error associated with tab operations to a status object.

calls: Promise<{ moved: boolean; from: string; to?: string }>
(err: unknown) => { status: number; message: string } | null
